h:
这是我为测试模型的不同配置和提示而整理的工作流程。

上传内容包含我对 XY 输入提示 S/R 的设置，其中列出了我正在测试的许多详细提示及其权重。

我还有 CFG Scale、Steps、Sampler/Scheduler 节点，但它们被设置为绕过，只需连接它们代替 XY 输入提示来测试它们，但相同的 XY Plot 节点将起作用。

o.en:
This is the workflow I put together for testing different configurations and prompts for models.

The upload contains my setup for XY Input Prompt S/R where I list out a number of detail prompts that I am testing with and their weights.

I also have the CFG Scale, Steps, Sampler/Scheduler nodes but they are set to bypass just connect them in place of the XY Input Prompt to test them but the same XY Plot node will work.
